Date : 06.04.2026.
 1. The applicant is apprehending hi
 connection with Crime No.141/2026 registered with Police
 Station, Ural, Tq. Balapur, District Akola for the offence
 punishable under Sections 118(1), 118(2), 115(2), 351(2),
 352, 189(2), 189(4), 190, 191(2), 191(3) of the Bhartiya
 Nyay Sanhita, 2023.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the applicant as wel  the learned APP for the non-applicant/State.
Perused the  case diary.

3. On 05.03.2026 at about 7.30 a.m., when the co-  accused was loading Bengal gram (chana) in his bolero  vehicle, the complainant came there in an autorikshaw and  an altercation took place between them on account of  removing vehicle the from the way, which turned into  hurling abuses and thereafter led to a fight.
It is alleged   the applicant pulled the father of the complainant out of th  autorikshaw and assaulted him by means of an iron rod on  2 85 aba233.26.odt his head.

Thereafter, the other co-accused persons - Shaikh Mobin Shaikh Ayyub, Shaikh Moib Shaikh Mobin and Shaikh Mojahid Shaikh Mobin assaulted the complainant by means of wooden sticks, whereby the complainant sustained fracture injury on his fingers.
Therefore, on the complaint of the complainant, the aforesaid offences came to be lodged against the applicant and co-accused.

1 4.
It appears that the applicant is a relative of the husband of the sister of the complainant and the relations between are strained.
An offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code has been registered against the husband of the sister of the complainant.
Be that as it may, the assault by means of a stick whereby, the complainant sustained fracture injury to his fingers is attributed to the co- accused, who has been granted anticipatory bail.
The only role attributed to other applicant is that he assaulted the father of the complainant.
5. It appears that most part of the investigation is already over.
So far as the anxiety of the learned APP regarding seizure of the iron rod is concerned, the applicant can be put to stringent conditions.

6. Considering these aspects, the role assigned to the applicant and more particularly, the fact that the fracture injury is not attributed to the present applicant, a case is made out for grant of anticipatory bail.

Hence, the following order:
 3 85 aba233.26.odt  ORDER (i) The application is allowed and disposed of.

(ii) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.141/2026 registered with Police Station, Ural,
Tq. Balapur, District Akola for the offence punishable under Sections 118(1), 118(2), 115(2), 351(2),
352, 189(2), 189(4), 190, 191(2), 191(3) of the Bhartiya Nyay Sanhita, 2023, applicant - Shaikh Imran Shaikh Kayum be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond of 25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station on every Wednesday and Sunday between 10.00 am to 12.00 noon for the next two weeks and cooperate with the investigating authority.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not threaten the prosecution witnesses.
(iv) So far as recovery of the iron rod is concerned, presence of the applicant shall be treated as custody within the meaning of Section 23 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.
